formula.label: Inspection priority / 100 (assumed operational rule, not a prediction)
formula.expression: min(100, type + proximity + cluster_size + growth + elderly)
formula.missing: Missing components add zero priority points and remain unavailable, not an observed zero. Weights are not redistributed.
formula.cluster_choice: Use the nearest verified cluster block; break ties by larger cluster, then source cluster ID. No double-counting cases across nearby clusters.
